Name: No Collision Multiplayer
Author: ninjor1
Description:
[size=5][b]Walk through your animals, pets, Junimos and more, in multiplayer too[/b][/size]
Lets you walk through pets, horses, Junimos, villagers, farm animals and monsters instead of getting stuck on them. It works for every player in a multiplayer game, including the Junimos which harvest for a Junimo Hut.

[size=5][b]Why another one?[/b][/size]
In multiplayer, a character made on the host (like a Junimo from a hut) is only passable on the host's computer, so other players keep bumping into it. This mod makes each player's own game let them through, so everyone who has it can walk through.

[size=5][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Walk through pets, horses, Junimos, farm animals, and optionally villagers and monsters.[/*]
[*]Monsters can't hurt you while you can walk through them.[/*]
[*]Every kind is switched on or off in config.json, or in game with Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Settings[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Pets, horses, Junimos and farm animals: on by default.[/*]
[*]Villagers and monsters: off by default.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]In multiplayer, every player who wants to walk through things needs it installed.[/*]
[*]Don't use it together with the original No Collision Mod, since they do the same job.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Source, bugs and suggestions[/b][/size]
The source code is at https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods. Please report bugs and make suggestions as issues there.

[size=5][b]Thanks[/b][/size]
To tbonehunter, whose No Collision Mod gave me the idea.
